title: Operation “No Bell”: Coordinated criticism of the US and allies
summary: OpenAI banned accounts linked to a previously unreported, likely Russia-origin operation we dubbed "No Bell", using AI to produce criticism of the US and its allies for audiences across Africa.
body: OpenAI banned accounts linked to a previously unreported, likely Russia-origin operation we dubbed "No Bell", using AI to produce criticism of the US and its allies for audiences across Africa.
summaryZh: OpenAI封禁了名为“No Bell”的行动网络，该网络利用AI生成针对美国及其盟友的批评内容，主要针对非洲受众。这是AI被用于地缘政治影响力的典型案例。
